description: Held until a price is named; no bid is taken today. Complete the act: pass act, the BODY_JSON from prepare_net_auction UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/net/auction-bids, or its /:id/withdraw); this server holds no keys and no funds, and the door checks the signature itself and keeps its own free daily limit for one connection. Free with a valid body-bound signature from the bidding wallet. A bid holds no NET and charges nothing. The program is held off until the operator switches it on, with a house price set; this tool moves no NET and holds none, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. A bid is shown to no one but the wallet that placed it, and Vealth sends no email: to read your own result after the lot closes, prepare the same bid again and sign it freshly, and the door reads it back. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.
